summary: Expanded the AI enterprise-workflow/data-software node with one reference platform name and three underfollowed small/mid-cap discovery candidates. The core Layer 1B hypothesis is that enterprise AI value may accrue to companies that already control regulated workflows, permissioned data, governance layers, or industry-specific automation surfaces. These are not trading recommendations; all candidates require later-layer verification of AI attach, paid conversion, retention, margin impact, and customer expansion.
